events.title: 2026 Stifel Birds of Prey — Free Seven-Race Men's and Women's Alpine World Cup Festival
events.time: Men: Dec 3 & 4 at 11 AM, Dec 5 at 10:30 AM, Dec 6 at 10 AM and 1 PM; Women: Dec 11, 12 & 13 at 11 AM (MST)
events.location: John & Karen Arnold Red Tail Stadium, Beaver Creek Resort, Beaver Creek, CO, USA; free concerts in Beaver Creek Village
events.cost: General spectator admission and grandstands FREE, $0 for family of 5; free shuttles. Official free Elk/Bear lot parking for vehicles with 5+ occupants on race days (capacity limited). VIP, food, premium concerts, travel and lodging extra.
events.age: General public/all ages; open free race spectator access; no residency or membership requirement stated.
events.description: Exceptional 2026 record event: SEVEN men's and women's Audi FIS alpine World Cup races over two consecutive weekends (first time this many Birds of Prey races since course debuted 1997), including fast downhill, Super-G and giant slalom; unusual FREE general admission AND free first-come grandstands, free shuttle, free parking with 5 car passengers, live free village concerts and athlete autograph events. Race-day schedule and public access verified by organizer official https://bcworldcup.com/birds-of-prey-menswomens/ and parking details https://bcworldcup.com/plan-your-visit/race-day-info/ ; free music https://bcworldcup.com/illenium-nathaniel-rateliff-headliners-2026/ (separate ILLENIUM/Nathaniel Rateliff ticketed performances NOT free). From Beaver Creek base, free race shuttle plus about five-minute uphill walk on snow; allow ~1 hour from base to stadium. No booking for free general admission specified. Distinct from Copper Mountain Stifel Copper Cup Nov28-29; exclude regular concerts from event identity. For 2026 Colorado friends before user's family arrives summer 2027. Westminster 80234 exact travel distance not verified.
